settings.title: What is Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream?
settings.content: Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream is a self-heating topical cream for treating and relieving achy joints. It’s the world’s first topical solution for Degenerative Disorder. It combines a blend of Bio-Active Growth Factors, ThermalWave Technology, and a Joint Support Formula to support joint cartilage healing, and relieve joint discomfort.

settings.title: What is Degenerative Disorder?
settings.content: Your body uses collagen and stem cells to repair your joint cartilage from injuries and daily wear-and-tear. But as you get older, your stem cells become dormant and natural collagen levels decline. When your stem cells and collagen can no longer keep up with your body’s needs to maintain healthy pain-free joints, this is called Degenerative Disorder. Degenerative Disorder can lead to your joint health worsening over time, and chronic joint discomfort.

settings.title: What are bioactive growth factors?
settings.content: Bioactive growth factors are components that have been studied to help rebuild tissue and cartilage by stimulating nearby bone cells. A biofactor called FGF-2 has been shown in studies to stimulate almost all types of cells including types of stem cells, to function to regenerate and stimulate joint tissue repair.

settings.title: Which bioactive growth factors are in Cellnergy Power Cream?
settings.content: LAMININE contains FGF-2 (Fibroblast Growth Factor-2), TGF (Transforming Growth Factor), and PDGF (Platelet Derived Growth Factor).These growth factors have been shown to support the re-activation of stem cells and to promote natural collagen production to combat Degenerative Disorder.

settings.title: What is FGF-2?
settings.content: FGF-2 (Fibroblast Growth Factor-2) is one of the egg bioactive growth factors found in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream. It has been shown in studies to play a role in supporting the activation of stem cells to help stimulate cartilage production to help with joint relief.

settings.title: What is ThermalWave Technology?
settings.content: Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream combines a proprietary blend of ingredients including a natural sensory agent and healing Infrared Energy to create its unique ThermalWave Technology. This is what makes the cream self heating to produce a warming, soothing feeling when you apply it to your skin and joints. This ThermalWave Technology stimulates blood flow and improves cellular activity. Studies have also demonstrated this Infrared Energy is a safe and effective therapy for relieving joint discomfort.

settings.title: What makes Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream Self Heating?
settings.content: The ThermalWave Technology in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream contains an all-natural sensory agent to provide warming relief to your skin and joints.

settings.title: What makes Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream different from other skin creams and supplements?
settings.content: Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream is the world’s first topical solution for degenerative disorder. Unlike other alternatives to joint discomfort, it doesn’t just treat the symptoms. It provides quick relief for joint discomfort through its ThermalWave Technology and provides long-term benefits through tackling the root cause of Degenerative Disorder. It achieves this by re-activating your body’s stem cells and bolstering collagen production to promote healthy cartilage repair and smooth and supple joint function.

settings.title: How does Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream work with other supplements?
settings.content:
Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream is designed to work in parallel with the Cellnergy Wellness Device and our breakthrough stem-cell supplement LAMININE.

The Cellnergy Wellness Device emits terahertz waves that penetrate deep into your joint tissue to resonate at the same frequency as healthy cells. When used in conjunction with Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream, the device can bolster absorption, promote the cellular activation of stem cells, and support the cellular regeneration of collagen to aid joint cartilage repair. 

And LAMININE is a stem cell regeneration supplement designed to combat Degenerative Disorder. When you combine this oral supplement with the Power Cream’s topical absorption, you can be confident your body has everything it needs for optimal joint cartilage repair.

settings.title: Where do the growth factors in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream come from?
settings.content: The proprietary blend of growth factors in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream come from fertilized avian eggs. These eggs are sourced from a United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) inspected poultry farm in the USA. The chickens are raised cage-free and are fed high quality whole grains.

settings.title: What makes the fertilized avian egg extract different from normal eggs you can purchase at the grocery store?
settings.content: The eggs used in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream are naturally fertilized eggs, incubated for a very specific time and temperature, to extract growth factors at their peak activity. The eggs are non-GMO, and no chemicals or extreme heat are used in processing the fertilized avian egg extract to maintain the function and activity of growth factors.

settings.title: Does Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream contain stem cells?
settings.content: No, Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream does not contain stem cells. Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream contains FGF2 which has been shown in studies to stimulate activity of the stem cells in the body to support joint cartilage repair.

settings.title: What are the ingredients in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream?
settings.content: The main ingredients in Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream are the proprietary blend of Bio-Active Growth Factors and the natural blend of ingredients that produce its ThermalWave Technology. Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream is also infused with a joint support formula to promote healthy joint functioning.

settings.title: Who should not use Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream?
settings.content:
Anyone over the age of 12 can use Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream. 

Though this cream is considered safe for everyone, if you’re expecting a child or you’re nursing and you want to give Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream a try, you should consult with your physician first. If you have any concerns or medical conditions, please consult with your physician first before taking Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream.

Do not take Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream if you are allergic to eggs.

settings.title: Is it safe to use Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream with other skin creams, medications and supplements?
settings.content: Yes it is safe, since Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream does not interfere with any other creams, medication or dietary supplements.

settings.title: Are there any side effects when using Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream?
settings.content: Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream has no known side effects.

settings.title: How often should Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream be used?
settings.content: Cellnergy Wellness Power Cream can be applied to your body and joints twice per day for best results.
